set.body: Add a public FitCamera action using the same canonical centers, bilateral offsets and camera basis as compilation. Fit into 90 percent of the reference viewport, clear pan, preserve viewpoint/orbit and non-camera state, and keep subsequent orbit camera distance stable. Perspective fit adjusts zoom; orthographic fit adjusts scale with zoom reset. Use existing camera compilation, not duplicated app math. Verify projected corners, depth containment, tightness, idempotence, translation invariance and state preservation on JVM/JS; verify real MNI app views and native interaction. The old standalone interaction probe currently fails before JavaFX picking at reference.pick(18,108); replace the assumed screen location with an actual native projection of an independently chosen interior point.
set.title: Fit canonical surface bounds explicitly at the current camera orientation
